svg.title: APEX 05 — Educate each persona on what matters to them
svg.text: WHAT WE SHOULD TEACH EACH PERSONA
Educate each persona on what matters to them
Customer education is persona-specific. Each card shows what to teach, the problem to highlight, the capability
to show, the material to use, what the persona should understand afterwards and the next action we want.

svg.text: Never send the same material to everyone. Executives get business value, managers get accountability, operations
get workflow, technology gets architecture and security, users get daily time savings, partners get revenue.
Capability status shown on the poster where relevant
Readiness: capabilities marked LIVE are built and tested; none is yet proven in a customer production environment. No customer results, ROI, certifications or prices are claimed.
